title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Predictive Validity for the Evaluation of LLM Agents
title_zh: 超越静态排行榜：用于评估 LLM Agents 的预测有效性
abstract_en: Agent benchmarks are growing fast, but no single benchmark touches more than four or five of the dimensions that deployment exposes. This paper aggregates the largest coordinated deep-dive of one MCP-based industrial-agent benchmark to date: fourteen parallel implementation studies covering new asset classes (including a multi-modal visual extension), alternative orchestrations, retrieval strategies, reasoning modes, infrastructure optimizations, and evaluation-methodology probes. Consolidating those studies with seven prior agent benchmarks, we argue that aggregate-score leaderboards systematically underspecify deployed-agent evaluation. Rankings derived from aggregate scores do not transfer to out-of-distribution settings; recent public-to-hidden competition retrospectives provide direct empirical evidence of this rank instability. We propose ranking configurations by predictive validity, the correlation between in-sample and out-of-sample rank, rather than in-sample mean, and report a twelve-tier measurement apparatus that exposes the deployment-relevant dimensions HELM and its agent-era successors collapse. The position is operationalized through three falsifiable out-of-distribution criteria with explicit thresholds; existing evidence partly supports it but is too thin to confirm. We close with a pre-registered pilot design and a field-level vision for what the next generation of agentic benchmarks should report.
abstract_zh: Agent benchmarks 正在快速增长，但没有任何单一 benchmark 能覆盖真实部署中暴露出的四五个以上关键维度。本文汇总了迄今规模最大的、围绕一个基于 MCP 的工业级 agent benchmark 的协同深度研究：14 项并行实现研究，涵盖新的资产类别（包括多模态视觉扩展）、不同编排方式、检索策略、推理模式、基础设施优化以及评估方法学探针。结合此前 7 个 agent benchmarks，作者指出，基于总分的排行榜系统性地低估了部署场景下 agent 评估的复杂性；由总分得到的排名无法稳定迁移到分布外设置，近期 public-to-hidden competition 的回顾性分析也为这种排名不稳定性提供了直接经验证据。论文主张用预测有效性（predictive validity）来排序配置，即关注样本内排名与样本外排名之间的相关性，而不是样本内平均分，并提出一个 12 层测量框架，以揭示 HELM 及其 agent 时代后继评测所压缩掉的部署相关维度。作者进一步给出 3 个可证伪的分布外判据及明确阈值；现有证据部分支持该观点，但仍不足以确认。最后，论文提出预注册 pilot 设计，并展望下一代 agentic benchmarks 应报告的内容。
key_points_zh: 论文批评当前 aggregate-score leaderboards：单一总分无法覆盖真实部署中的多维风险与能力，导致 agent 评估被过度简化。
作者整合 14 项 MCP-based industrial-agent benchmark 深度研究与 7 个既有 agent benchmarks，展示不同资产类别、编排、检索、推理和基础设施设置会显著改变评测结论。
核心主张是用 predictive validity 排名：衡量样本内排名与分布外样本排名的相关性，而不是只看样本内平均分。
论文提出 12 层测量 apparatus，用于暴露 HELM 及后续 agent 评测框架中被折叠或忽略的部署相关维度。
作者给出 3 个带阈值的可证伪分布外判据，并设计预注册 pilot；但承认当前证据仍偏薄，尚不足以完全验证该评估范式。

llm_assessment.comment: The paper usefully challenges static agent leaderboards and promotes predictive-validity evaluation, though it is more evaluation methodology than runtime infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文有价值地质疑静态智能体排行榜并推动预测有效性评估，但更偏评测方法论而非运行时基础设施。
